name: Stud Wall Panel Type
description: A stud wall PanelType: exterior and interior sheeting layers of the given thicknesses, each a plate, and a core that fills the rest of the panel, framed with edge beams and studs. Features are framed.

inputParameters.name: exterior_sheeting_thickness
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Thickness of the exterior sheeting layer. Unset or 0: none.

inputParameters.name: interior_sheeting_thickness
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Thickness of the interior sheeting layer. Unset or 0: none.

inputParameters.name: standard_beam_width
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Default width of the framing beams. Default: 60.

inputParameters.name: stud_spacing
inputParameters.description: (Optional) On-centre stud spacing. Unset: 8 x stud width. 0: no studs.

inputParameters.name: edge_stud_width
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Width of the vertical edge studs. Unset: standard_beam_width.

inputParameters.name: top_plate_beam_width
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Width of the top plate beams. Unset: standard_beam_width.

inputParameters.name: bottom_plate_beam_width
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Width of the bottom plate beams. Unset: standard_beam_width.

inputParameters.name: detail_sets
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Detail sets (CT: Detail Agent Set): how features of the types they build are made in this panel type.

inputParameters.name: filepath
inputParameters.description: (Optional) A JSON file to write the type to when 'save' is True. Read it back with CT: Panel Type From JSON.

outputParameters.name: panel_type
outputParameters.description: PanelType. Connect to CT: Create Populator.

outputParameters.name: info
outputParameters.description: The type's thickness, layers, agents and detail sets.
